cards.name: Titanium Mastercard

rules.name: Travel/Lifestyle mode
rules.conditions: 2 Joy Points/AED in chosen mode after AED 3,000 monthly spend

cards.notes: Official Deem fee schedule (Mar 2026): annual fee AED 210, FX 2.99%, cash advance 3% or AED 105, late AED 241.50, retail interest 3.99%/month. Deem blog: 100 Joy Points = AED 0.50 cashback/gift card (AED 1 other redemptions), min redemption 15,000, expiry 24 months; accelerated earn needs AED 3,000 monthly spend, cap 50,000 points. Card page says first year free (saves AED 200) and also min salary AED 5,000; elsewhere page says 'free for life', which conflicts with the fee schedule. Exact points per AED (aggregator: 2) not on official pages. Not Islamic. Alt WIN draw mode.
